title: Egyptian-inspired Day/Night SCOBY–PLA Biocomposite Suit

concept_summary.ru: Футуристический образ египетского спецкостюма на основе высушенной бактериальной целлюлозы SCOBY в сочетании с артикулированной PLA-сеткой и отдельной исследовательской сенсорной электроникой SkinGPT. Эстетика древнеегипетских погребальных обмоток и современного функционального снаряжения.
concept_summary.en: Egyptian-inspired speculative day/night full-body suit combining bacterial-cellulose bio-leather, articulated 3D-printed PLA mesh, modular panels, and a future SkinGPT sensing concept. Visual design only; not functional or certified body armor.

image.author_credit: JANUS SCOBY/SkinGPT owner-directed concept; AI-assisted visual rendition
image.disclaimer: Illustration is fiction, not photographed prototype nor validation of mechanical, thermal, biological or ballistic performance.

features: dark version of identical costume structure

proposed_material_stack.layer: replaceable support and sensor pockets, electrically isolated
separate load-bearing protective panels (fictional in rendering)

design.operating_claims: No proven camouflage, low observability, sound attenuation, protective or ballistic function. Day/night are color variants for fictional presentation.

research_bridge.old_armor_context: historical June/July 2026 Ukrainian documents with 346 MPa and 13 GPa simulated hemp-BC laminate estimate; never measured on this costume
research_bridge.optical: data/JANUS_PLA_GLOW_ESP32_OPTICAL_MEMORY_001.json (external separated track, no direct wet SCOBY contact)
research_bridge.novel_idea_to_validate: Growing bacterial cellulose around mobile, jointed 3D printed PLA mesh and testing mechanical freedom, flexion fatigue, and sensor performance
research_bridge.prior_art: Modern Synthesis already grows bacterial cellulose around yarn scaffolds; generic concept of bacterial cellulose growing on textiles is known. Articulated PLA chainmail and SkinGPT coupling remain hypothesis.
